verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Authy offering a CLI or API that lets an agent read a current TOTP code from a user's vault. The documented Authy API and SDK let developers add 2FA verification to their own apps, which is a different capability. That API is also closed to new customers and slated for deprecation. Community reports say the only way to get token secrets out is unofficial hacks through deprecated clients, a user-side workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can fetch a current TOTP code programmatically — via CLI or API — to complete a 2FA login inside an automated workflow
